name: productboard
label: Productboard
description: Productboard is a product management tool that helps you manage your product roadmap and features.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
Your Productboard API Key.

To obtain your API Key:
1. Go to https://app.productboard.com/
2. Log in to your account
3. Go to Settings → Integrations → Public API
4. Generate a new API Key
5. Copy the Key and paste it here

create_note.label: Create Note
create_note.description: Creates a new note in Productboard

content.label: Content
content.description: HTML-encoded rich text content of the feedback note

user_email.label: User Email
user_email.description: Email address of a user to be attached to the note. This field can't be combined with `Company Domain`.

company_domain.label: Company Domain
company_domain.description: Domain of a company the note should be linked to. This field can't be combined with `User Email`.

display_url.label: Display URL
display_url.description: URL where the external entity can be accessed.

source_origin.label: Source Origin
source_origin.description: A unique string identifying the external system from which the data came.

source_record_id.label: Source Record ID
source_record_id.description: The unique id of the record in the origin system.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: A set of tags for categorizing the note.

update_feature.label: Update Feature
update_feature.description: Updates an existing feature in Productboard.

get_feature.label: Get Feature
get_feature.description: Get an existing feature in Productboard
